label: Ludwig Wittgenstein, Über Gewißheit §94…: Über Gewißheit §§94-97: my world-picture is not held…
locator: §94, mein Weltbild habe ich nicht, weil ich mich von seiner Richtigkeit überzeugt habe
interpretation: §94: the world-picture is 'der überkommene Hintergrund, auf welchem ich zwischen wahr und falsch unterscheide'. §95: the sentences describing it could belong to a kind of mythology, with a role like that of rules of a game. §96-97: hardened and fluid sentences can change places; the river-bed can shift, though bed and water are distinguished.
attribution: The passage states that the world-picture is not held from conviction of its correctness but is the inherited background against which true and false are distinguished, functioning like rules of a game and able to shift, which is the premise.
